Author:     Aria Wegrzyn <aria@ariac.at>
AuthorDate: Thu Apr 9 08:07:35 2026 +1200
Commit:     Aria Wegrzyn <aria@ariac.at>
CommitDate: Thu Apr 9 08:07:35 2026 +1200

    Bug 2028925 - Add creation and modified dates to calendar task tree. r=aleca,dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D291796

diff --git a/calendar/base/content/calendar-task-tree-view.js b/calendar/base/content/calendar-task-tree-view.js
index 4ce6941ff24..809151b2e11 100644
--- a/calendar/base/content/calendar-task-tree-view.js
+++ b/calendar/base/content/calendar-task-tree-view.js
@@ -306,6 +306,9 @@ class CalendarTaskTreeView {
         return task.recurrenceInfo
           ? cal.l10n.getDateFmtString("Repeating")
           : this._formatDateTime(task[property]);
+      case "creationDate":
+      case "lastModifiedTime":
+        return this._formatDateTime(task[property]);
       case "percentComplete":
         return task.percentComplete > 0 ? task.percentComplete + "%" : "";
       case "categories":
diff --git a/calendar/base/content/calendar-task-tree.js b/calendar/base/content/calendar-task-tree.js
index a212dcb3063..7ecb98a902b 100644
--- a/calendar/base/content/calendar-task-tree.js
+++ b/calendar/base/content/calendar-task-tree.js
@@ -177,6 +177,18 @@
                      closemenu="none"
                      data-l10n-id="calendar-event-listing-column-due-date"/>
             <splitter class="tree-splitter"/>
+            <treecol class="calendar-task-tree-col-creationdate"
+                     itemproperty="creationDate"
+                     style="flex: 1 auto"
+                     closemenu="none"
+                     data-l10n-id="calendar-event-listing-column-creation-date"/>
+            <splitter class="tree-splitter"/>
+            <treecol class="calendar-task-tree-col-lastmodifiedtime"
+                     itemproperty="lastModifiedTime"
+                     style="flex: 1 auto"
+                     closemenu="none"
+                     data-l10n-id="calendar-event-listing-column-last-modified-time"/>
+            <splitter class="tree-splitter"/>
             <treecol class="calendar-task-tree-col-duration"
                      itemproperty="duration"
                      sortKey="dueDate"
diff --git a/calendar/base/modules/utils/calUnifinderUtils.sys.mjs b/calendar/base/modules/utils/calUnifinderUtils.sys.mjs
index 7d36bd34b4d..839b3a58b54 100644
--- a/calendar/base/modules/utils/calUnifinderUtils.sys.mjs
+++ b/calendar/base/modules/utils/calUnifinderUtils.sys.mjs
@@ -33,6 +33,8 @@ export var unifinder = {
       case "startDate":
       case "dueDate":
       case "endDate":
+      case "creationDate":
+      case "lastModifiedTime":
       case "completedDate":
         if (aItem[aKey] == null) {
           return -62168601600000000; // ns value for (0000/00/00 00:00:00)
@@ -79,6 +81,8 @@ export var unifinder = {
       case "startDate":
       case "endDate":
       case "dueDate":
+      case "creationDate":
+      case "lastModifiedTime":
       case "entryDate":
         return sortCompare.date_filled;
 
diff --git a/calendar/locales/en-US/calendar/calendar-event-listing.ftl b/calendar/locales/en-US/calendar/calendar-event-listing.ftl
index c8bc8452d8e..5a9566565c8 100644
--- a/calendar/locales/en-US/calendar/calendar-event-listing.ftl
+++ b/calendar/locales/en-US/calendar/calendar-event-listing.ftl
@@ -33,6 +33,14 @@ calendar-event-listing-column-end-date =
   .label = End
   .tooltiptext = Sort by end date
 
+calendar-event-listing-column-creation-date =
+  .label = Created
+  .tooltiptext = Sort by creation date
+
+calendar-event-listing-column-last-modified-time =
+  .label = Modified
+  .tooltiptext = Sort by last modified date
+
 calendar-event-listing-column-location =
   .label = Location
   .tooltiptext = Sort by location
